description: Defines the class 'ru_dummy_sector' which implements a dummy sector for a radio unit (RU) in a 3GPP-like system. It handles downlink data, uplink requests, PRACH occasions, manages request buffers, and tracks metrics related to requests and late requests.

classes.name: ru_dummy_sector
classes.description: Implements a dummy radio unit (RU) sector handling downlink, uplink, PRACH, and metrics tracking.

methods.name: handle_dl_data
methods.description: Handles incoming downlink data requests, checks for late requests, updates metrics, and logs warnings.

methods.name: handle_prach_occasion
methods.description: Handles PRACH occasions, checks for late requests, updates metrics, and logs warnings.

methods.name: handle_new_uplink_slot
methods.description: Handles new uplink slot requests, checks for late requests, updates metrics, and logs warnings.

methods.name: new_slot_boundary
methods.description: Processes slot boundary, retrieves and validates requests, and notifies symbol and PRACH data.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the RU dummy sector processing.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the RU dummy sector processing.

methods.name: collect_metrics
methods.description: Collects and reports metrics related to requests and late requests.
